events.title: Chloroform's Anaesthetic Power Is Discovered
events.description: In Edinburgh, Scottish physician James Young Simpson discovered the anaesthetic properties of chloroform. He and his colleagues tested it on themselves.
events.significance: Chloroform soon became widely used in surgery and childbirth. It helped change how pain was managed in medicine.

events.title: The Steps to Tutankhamun's Tomb Are Found
events.description: Howard Carter's excavation team in Egypt's Valley of the Kings uncovered the top of a buried staircase. It led to a sealed doorway.
events.significance: The staircase led to the tomb of Tutankhamun. It was the best-preserved royal tomb ever found in Egypt, and it set off worldwide fascination with ancient Egypt.

events.title: The Iran Hostage Crisis Begins
events.description: Militant students stormed the U.S. Embassy in Tehran and took about 90 hostages. They were angry that the deposed Shah had been admitted to the United States.
events.significance: The standoff lasted 444 days. It reshaped U.S.–Iran relations and influenced American politics for years.

events.title: Barack Obama Is Elected President
events.description: Senator Barack Obama of Illinois defeated Senator John McCain of Arizona in the U.S. presidential election.
events.significance: Obama became the 44th U.S. president and the first African American to hold the office.
